findings.statement: [RETAINED_OPEN_SCIENTIFIC_BLOCKER; PROPOSED REMEDY] Governing condition: for entropy-scaled state u=u_eq(z)+v, project P onto the exact collision invariants/slow thermal coordinates and Q=I-P. A legitimate early-prefix reduction requires a computable norm M and uniform coercivity mu_M(Q J_C Q)<=-lambda, a nonlinear remainder bound L||v||_M on radius rho with lambda_eff=lambda-L rho>0, and forcing r=Q(F(u_eq,z)-D u_eq z'); then ||v(N)||_M is bounded by exp(-integral lambda_eff)B0 plus the corresponding convolution of ||r||. Propagate that state defect through an adjoint/dual-weighted residual to every endpoint quantity and add radial/tail enclosures. Only if the total bound is below a prospectively frozen fraction (suggested one half) of each hard scientific tolerance may an index-1 equilibrium-manifold DAE replace the stalled prefix. This is an analytically constrained domain reduction/rigorous surrogate, unlike generic optimization or BGK penalization without an exact residual certificate. Scaling uses entropy variables and per-component equilibrium scales, preserving collision invariants, 0<f<1, positive temperatures, energy closure, and the full cold endpoint. Online complexity should be O(r^3+cost(Jv)) per reduced step versus dense full-system work; offline projected spectral/interval work can be O(n^3) and must fit the existing budget with margin. No such coercivity, remainder, tail, or QoI certificate exists in the supplied evidence, so D-071 remains open and the physical proposition remains undecided.
assumptions_used: The early high-temperature dynamics admit a normally attracting equilibrium manifold after exact invariant projection.
The discrete collision operator has a physically meaningful entropy-weighted norm and its nullspace exactly matches conserved slow variables.
A posteriori state and event/QoI estimates remain reliable through the switch and full endpoint evolution.
The gate's fixed wall budget and blinded scientific tolerances are unchanged.

findings.statement: [RETAINED_OPEN_EVIDENCE_DEFECT] Governing condition: a JVP probe must be local in a dimensionless variable z=D^{-1}u, with D_i fixed from physical component scales, and must remain inside the strict domain. For a centered real probe, choose eta proportional to machine-epsilon^(1/3) and require ||D^{-1}(F(u+eta Dv)-F(u-eta Dv))/(2 eta)-D^{-1}J(u)Dv|| to show the expected O(eta^2)+O(eps/eta) ladder; complex-step is admissible only if the entire branch is analytic. A global norm dominated by elapsed seconds violates this condition and can move N nonlocally. Arnoldi dimension-one termination certifies an invariant direction only when the Hessenberg residual is zero within a scaled bound and repeated under independent admissible seeds; otherwise it is inconclusive. Static JVPs cannot establish trajectory existence, reaction-tail authority, or endpoint QoI error. Remedy: rescale N, temperatures, logits, abundances, and elapsed time separately; project exact invariants; use admissible symmetric directions; record residual norms and compare AD/complex-step/high-precision stencils. Complexity is two RHS calls per centered JVP plus O(kn) Arnoldi storage. This repairs probe meaning but, by itself, cannot reopen D-071.
assumptions_used: The RHS is twice differentiable along each real admissible probe; complex-step additionally requires analyticity and no nonanalytic branches.
D is fixed prospectively and does not use hidden endpoint outputs.
Strict occupation and temperature domains are enforced on both perturbations.

The recorded about 3.5 percent drift violates the hard threshold and a normal xfail is not closure.

findings.statement: [OPEN_CONFIRMED_CURRENT_CODE_DEFECT_WITH_INTERFACE_NO_GO] A strict total attempt cap A requires the invariant accepted+error_test_failures+nonlinear_failures<=A at every return, including work hidden inside one dependency step.
